notes: Current Tax Year 2026-27; resident individual under 60; ordinary fully taxable salary only; gross limited to 50 lakh. AY 2026-27 filing guidance describes the previous income year and is not the primary basis.

old.label: Old regime
old.source_title: Finance Act 2026, section 3 and First Schedule Part I-B paragraph A(I); Income-tax Act 2025, sections 19 and 156(1)
old.verified_by: Codex enacted-primary-source check; human review pending
old.notes: Under 60 only. Standard deduction is capped at salary. Additional deductions must be an already-eligible user-supplied aggregate excluding the standard deduction; eligibility is not calculated. No old-regime rebate marginal relief is applied.

new.label: New regime
new.source_title: Income-tax Act 2025, sections 19(1) table item 2, 156(2)-(3) and 202(1)
new.verified_by: Codex enacted-primary-source check; human review pending
new.notes: Resident individual; ordinary slab income only. Above 12 lakh, marginal relief limits pre-cess slab tax to the excess income where applicable. No special-rate income or additional new-regime deductions modeled.

cess.verified_by: Codex enacted-primary-source check; human review pending
cess.notes: Health and Education Cess after rebate/marginal relief. Surcharge excluded: gross salary capped at 50 lakh, so neither rounded taxable income exceeds 50 lakh.

rounding.verified_by: Codex enacted-primary-source check; human review pending
rounding.notes: Round total income to nearest 10 rupees before slab/rebate calculation and final tax including cess to nearest 10 rupees. Ignore paise before determining the last rupee digit; five rounds up.
